== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ベイダーの執念</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の移動フェイズに、ベイダーが隣接位置からルークのいる位置へ移動した時に使う。二人の間で決闘を行う。双方ともに、運命数を2回引いて、戦闘力に加える。勝者は点数の差の分だけ、失ったフォースを回復させることができる。敗者は同数のフォースを失い、戦闘を行ったキャラクターをロストデッキへ送る。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ベイダーはすべてのジェダイを狩り出し、抹殺しようとした。最後の一人、オビ＝ワンを倒した彼は、若きスカイウォーカーに目を転じた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Vader's Obsession.

'''Lore''' — Vader sought to hunt down and eliminate all Jedi. After defeating the last one, Obi-Wan, he turned his attention to the young Skywalker.

'''Game text''' — During your move phase, play when Vader moves from an adjacent location to Luke’s location. The two duel. Each draws destiny twice and adds those values to power. The winner may recover lost Force equal to the difference. The loser loses the same amount of Force and sends the dueling character to the Lost Pile.

The Japanese explicitly sends the losing character to the Lost Pile. The original English says the loser loses the character as well as the Force.<ref>[[:File:P2P-D-vadersobsession.gif|Original English face]], [[Vader's Obsession]].</ref>
